paragraphs.text: Senior Software Engineer with 12 years of experience designing and optimizing large-scale applications. Skilled in full-stack development, cloud architecture, and microservices design. Recognized for leading teams that deliver high-performing software products, reduce technical debt, and improve system reliability. Adept at mentoring junior engineers and driving engineering best practices to support organizational growth.
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of California, Berkeley
Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE Programmer | 2016
Spearheaded the migration of a legacy monolithic system to a microservices-based architecture, reducing downtime incidents by 40% and
Directed development of a customer-facing web application that improved user engagement by 25% and generated $5M in additional annual revenue
Introduced automated testing frameworks that improved code quality and reduced production defects by 30% across the engineering team
Apex Systems | San Jose, CA, | June 2013 – May 2017
Built backend services using Java and Spring, improving API response times by 18% and supporting 200K+ daily active users
Collaborated with product and UX teams to launch a mobile app feature that boosted retention rates by 22% within six months
Optimized database queries and indexing strategies, reducing average query time from 3.2 seconds to under 1 second
